title: Founder personal-brand headshot session: neutralise six differently-lit studio looks to an in-frame grey card and one authored signature grade, author the retouched hero + mono + profile crops, vectorize the monogram, and data-merge a brand board
grounding_note: Adapted from a real Freelancer.com creative-headshot brief (a founder wanting a 'creative and dynamic headshot for my professional business profile,' shot 'in a studio' with 'studio lighting' and 'creative and dynamic compositions'). The live studio shoot itself is out of connector scope, so the task is faithfully scoped to the POST-PRODUCTION + personal-brand delivery a creative-headshot retoucher hands over once the raw studio frames exist. The client is laundered to a FICTIONAL unnamed founder with a generic two-letter personal monogram ('AV'); no real person, company, product, platform or trademark is named (only Adobe as the tool platform and Freelancer.com as the sourcing site). REPOSITIONED for connector reality and to restore the amputated batch: the founder did not sit for one frame — a real personal-brand session captures SEVERAL looks in one day, so the client supplies SIX raw studio captures of the same founder shot under six deliberately different lighting setups across the session, each with a neutral 18% grey balance card clipped in frame as tethered-shoot practice. The retoucher must (1) neutralise every look to its own in-frame grey card and carry ONE authored signature personal-brand grade across all six so the profile set reads as a single deliberate identity rather than six mismatched snapshots; (2) fully produce the signature hero look — believable selective retouch, a soft subject-from-backdrop separation, a wide reframed hero, a monochrome alternate, and the profile avatar + banner crops; (3) vectorize the founder's flat monogram into a crisp logomark; and (4) hand back an authored personal-brand board that lays the six looks and the mark out as a client-facing delivery piece. Reasonable enrichment (the six-look count, the in-frame card, the crop dimensions, the signature-look targets, the monogram, the brand board) is all consistent with 'creative/dynamic headshot for a professional business profile'; nothing contradicts the source. No generative fill/expand, no compositing, no text-to-image, no from-scratch design, no upscaling is claimed.
one_line_ask: Take a founder's six raw studio headshot looks (each carrying an in-frame grey card) shot under six different lightings, neutralise every look to its card and carry one authored signature personal-brand grade across the set, fully produce the signature hero (selective retouch, background separation, wide reframe, mono alt, profile avatar + banner), vectorize the flat monogram, and data-merge an authored personal-brand board of the looks plus the mark.
full_brief:
I'm a founder rebuilding my professional profile and personal-brand page, and I need the finished delivery set from my studio session. My photographer shot me in one studio day but moved the lights and backdrop around between setups, so the raw exports do NOT match each other out of camera — some run warm, some cool, one has a colour tinge, they sit at different brightnesses. Because we knew the light kept changing, a neutral 18% grey balance card was clipped into every frame.

Here is the whole job, working only from the files I provide:

1. Make the set read as ONE deliberate identity, not six different days. Use the grey card in each frame as your ground truth: every look must be neutralised so its card reads truly neutral (no residual warm, cool or colour cast) and so the card's mid-grey sits at the same brightness across all six — one common white point across the whole set.

2. Then carry ONE signature look across all six — my personal-brand grade: a warm, clean, editorial feel with gentle contrast, a consistent warm bias and a soft matte shadow foot, restrained clarity and just a whisper of vibrance, identical head to head. The catch my last editor missed: keep my skin natural and true — the grade cannot push my face orange or plastic while it lifts the rest of the frame.

3. Fully finish my signature hero look: tasteful believable retouching (brighten my eyes and teeth a little without touching skin texture or reshaping my face), separate me from the backdrop with a soft blur behind me so it feels dynamic, and reframe that look into a wide landscape hero with breathing room on one side for an overlaid headline. Give me a tasteful monochrome alternate of that hero for places that want black-and-white, and the two crops I'll actually upload: a 1:1 avatar and a wide profile banner, both off the finished hero.

4. Vectorize my flat monogram PNG into a clean scalable logomark so it stays razor-sharp on print and large web.

5. Finally, lay the looks out as a client-facing personal-brand board — one page per look, each showing that look's finished portrait, my name and its usage label, with my logomark on every page — and hand it back as one print-ready PDF, one look per page.

Deliverables: the six neutralised card-bearing reference masters I can eyeball the cards against, plus the six signature-graded look masters as one matched set; the finished signature hero (colour + mono + 1:1 avatar + profile banner); the vector logomark; and the personal-brand board PDF. Along with the images, hand back a short note listing the final white-balance and exposure move you made on each look and the skin protection you applied, so I can confirm they were matched to the card and not just eyeballed.

inputs.name: look01_signature_raw.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Straight-out-of-camera un-retouched studio business headshot of a 38-year-old founder (fictional, Anouk Vaziri), head-and-shoulders framed slightly off-centre with generous empty seamless mid-grey backdrop to camera-left, lit by warm tungsten key + fill studio strobes so the frame carries a clear WARM/amber cast and slightly flat low contrast, neutral expression turning to a slight confident smile. A neutral 18% grey balance card (an 18% grey patch beside a small white patch) is clipped to the lapel and clearly visible in the lower frame. Real skin with visible pores, individual hair strands and a few flyaways, faint under-eye shadow, slightly dull un-retouched teeth and eyes, faint sensor noise, frame very slightly tilted ~1.5 degrees. 4000x5000 portrait, documentary realism, NOT glossy, NOT CGI, no beauty retouching applied.
inputs.realism_notes: THE SIGNATURE HERO look and the reference frame that establishes the shared house target. Diagnosis (do NOT restate in brief/steps): WARM tungsten cast + slightly flat/under, so its corrective is to COOL the temperature and add contrast until the in-frame card reads neutral at the common mid-grey — the numbers become the shared white-point target the other five must hit. Generous backdrop to camera-left so the wide 16:9 hero reframe and the profile crops have room to work purely by cropping (no pixels invented), and so the card (lower frame) is cropped OUT of the delivered hero while staying present in the retained graded master. Only this look gets the full retouch (eyes/teeth, separation blur, wide reframe). 4000x5000 camera-scale so every downstream crop is downscale-only. NOT pre-graded.

inputs.name: look02_window_raw.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Straight-out-of-camera un-retouched studio headshot of the SAME 38-year-old founder (fictional, Anouk Vaziri), head-and-shoulders against the seamless mid-grey backdrop, lit by a large cool north-facing window so the frame reads clearly COOL/blue and a touch UNDER-exposed, flat contrast. A neutral 18% grey balance card (18% grey patch beside a white patch) is clipped in view at the lower frame. Real skin pores, individual hairs, natural texture, faint sensor noise. 4000x5000 portrait, documentary, un-retouched, NOT glossy, NOT CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: Alternate look #2. Diagnosis (confine to this field): COOL/blue + slightly under — the OPPOSITE corrective direction to the signature look, so a single shared white-balance across the set cannot neutralise both. This is the identical-params trap: copying the hero's cooling move here leaves this card blue and fails the gate. Grade to its own card, then the same shared signature constants.

inputs.name: look03_practical_raw.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Straight-out-of-camera un-retouched studio headshot of the SAME founder (fictional, Anouk Vaziri) against the mid-grey backdrop, lit by an overhead GREEN-ish fluorescent/LED practical so the frame carries a distinct green colour tinge, normal exposure, slightly dull. A neutral 18% grey balance card (18% grey and white patches) is clipped visibly at the lower edge. Real skin pores, fine flyaway hairs, natural texture. 4000x5000 portrait, documentary, un-retouched, NOT glossy, NOT CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: Alternate look #3. Diagnosis (confine to this field): GREEN cast needs a TINT correction (green->magenta), NOT a temperature move — a different colour axis from the warm/cool frames, forcing genuine per-frame reasoning rather than one slider. A temperature-only fix leaves the card green and fails the gate. Skin especially must have the residual green pulled out under the shared grade.

inputs.name: look04_neutral_raw.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Straight-out-of-camera un-retouched studio headshot of the SAME founder (fictional, Anouk Vaziri) against the mid-grey backdrop, wearing a genuinely warm ochre/rust blazer, lit by a clean neutral softbox at correct white balance so there is NO colour cast, only a slightly bright exposure. A neutral 18% grey balance card (18% grey patch beside a white patch) is clipped in view at the lower frame and already reads neutral. Real skin pores, individual hairs, natural texture. 4000x5000 portrait, documentary, un-retouched, NOT glossy, NOT CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: Alternate look #4 — THE HOLD-WB TRAP. Diagnosis (confine to this field): shot under clean neutral light, so its in-frame card ALREADY reads neutral and the founder's ochre blazer warmth is REAL wardrobe colour, not a white-balance error. The correct move is essentially NO white-balance shift — only pull the slight over-exposure down to match the set brightness. A naive agent that batch-applies the warm/cool corrections used on the other looks, or 'cools an imagined cast,' neutralises this card off-neutral and strips a colour that is genuinely present. The decision must be driven by THIS card, not the batch.

inputs.name: look05_mixed_raw.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Straight-out-of-camera un-retouched studio headshot of the SAME founder (fictional, Anouk Vaziri) against the mid-grey backdrop, lit by a MIX of cool window light on one side and a warm practical tube on the other so the cast is split and uneven across the face, normal exposure, flat contrast. A neutral 18% grey balance card (18% grey plus white patch) is propped in view in the lower frame. Real skin texture, pores, a few stray hairs. 4000x5000 portrait, documentary, un-retouched, NOT glossy, NOT CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: Alternate look #5. Diagnosis (confine to this field): split/mixed warm+cool cast is the hardest to neutralise — the agent must average temperature AND tint toward the card's neutral, accepting a compromise since the two sides disagree, driving the card grey even if one cheek stays slightly warmer. Different reasoning again from the single-cast frames.

inputs.name: look06_softbox_raw.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Straight-out-of-camera un-retouched studio headshot of the SAME founder (fictional, Anouk Vaziri) against the mid-grey backdrop, lit in cool open-shade through a large diffusion panel so the frame is cool-blue and slightly flat but at a SUBTLY different blue and brightness than a north-window frame, normal exposure. A neutral 18% grey balance card (18% grey patch beside a white patch) is clipped in view at the lower frame. Real skin pores, fine hairs, natural texture. 4000x5000 portrait, documentary, un-retouched, NOT glossy, NOT CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: Alternate look #6 — THE COPY TRAP. Diagnosis (confine to this field): cool like look02, but a subtly DIFFERENT blue and brightness, so its corrective is close-but-NOT-equal to the window frame's. An agent that copies look02's exact warm-up numbers onto this frame lands it off the shared white point; it must reason this card on its own. Grade to its card, then the same shared signature constants.

inputs.name: monogram_flat.png
inputs.gen_prompt: A flat, clean two-letter serif monogram wordmark 'AV' inside a thin circular ring, solid charcoal (#2B2B2B) on a transparent background, crisp geometric letterforms, no gradients, no texture, no photographic elements, generous transparent padding around the mark. 1600x1600, transparent PNG, centred.
inputs.realism_notes: Flat hard-edged solid-colour raster logo with clean boundaries and open letter counters (A counter and V are simple; the ring is a closed stroke, not a filled disc) so image_vectorize traces clean SVG paths after a crop-to-bounds prep. Transparent background, single ink colour. Because the ground is already transparent and the ink is a single flat colour, the only prep needed before trace is a crop-to-bounds so the trace does not waste resolution on the padding — no knock-to-transparency required here.

inputs.name: brandboard_template.indd
inputs.gen_prompt: AUTHORED DELIVERABLE (cannot be model-generated): a genuine, hand-built Adobe InDesign document (.indd/.idml) for a SINGLE-RECORD US Letter (8.5x11) portrait personal-brand board page — ONE look per page. It must carry live InDesign data-merge placeholder fields <<look_name>>, <<founder_name>>, <<tagline>>, and TWO @-prefixed image-path merge columns wired to two separate image frames: a large portrait frame bound to @portrait (that look's finished card-excluded portrait crop) and a small logomark frame bound to @logomark (the vectorized monogram). Because free-form image-at-coordinates placement is banned, the portrait and the mark reach the page ONLY as merge binds through these two image frames. Built by hand in InDesign so the merge fields and BOTH image frames actually bind. Explicitly NOT a convert_pdf_to_indd output and NOT a multi-record grid: document_merge_data_layout emits one file per row, so the template holds exactly one record's worth of fields; a converted-PDF template or a multi-up grid would not bind / cannot be produced.
inputs.realism_notes: document_merge_data_layout REQUIRES a user-authored .indd carrying real merge fields plus genuine @image-path columns, and it produces ONE FILE PER ROW — so a single-record board page is the correct, connector-doable shape (six rows -> six pages -> one PDF). Supplied as an input, not a chain output. TWO image columns (@portrait, @logomark) mean the merge resolves two prepped assets per row: the row's finished portrait crop AND the shared vectorized monogram, so both the chain-produced portraits and the chain-produced mark have a real connector-doable path onto every page without any free-form placement (mirrors the two-image-column merge pattern). Not a PDF-converted template.

inputs.name: brandboard_roster.csv
inputs.gen_prompt: Generate a CSV with columns look_name,founder_name,tagline,@portrait,@logomark holding SIX rows, one per look. look_name is a neutral usage label per row (Signature, Feature, Editorial, Profile, Speaker, Press); founder_name is the same fictional founder in every row (Anouk Vaziri); tagline is a short generic personal-brand line per row (e.g. 'Founder & Principal'). The @portrait column names that row's finished card-excluded portrait crop file (e.g. @look_signature_crop.jpg ... @look_press_crop.jpg) so the one-file-per-row merge drops each finished portrait into that page's portrait frame. The @logomark column holds the SAME vectorized monogram file (@monogram_logomark.svg) in EVERY row so the merge drops the one shared mark onto every page as a merge bind. Column names must exactly match the template fields <<look_name>>,<<founder_name>>,<<tagline>> and the two @image-path columns @portrait and @logomark.
inputs.realism_notes: Headers match the authored .indd fields and BOTH @-image columns so the one-file-per-row merge binds the copy, the correct per-look portrait, AND the shared monogram per page. @logomark carries the identical vectorized SVG path in all six rows. Six rows => the merge must produce exactly six finished pages. The look_name labels are usage labels only and carry NO lighting/correction diagnosis, so the data file leaks no method.

outputs.name: neutralized_card_masters_x6
outputs.spec: The six per-look NEUTRALISED reference masters — the RETAINED full-res card-bearing files produced by neutralising each look to its own in-frame grey card, delivered BEFORE the signature grade is applied (these are the neutrality-grading artifacts the harness keeps; the grey card is still present AND still genuinely neutral on them because no warm grade has been laid over it yet). Acceptance (grader-checked, evaluated on THESE neutralised masters ONLY — never on the warm signature-graded delivery and never on a card-removed crop): each look neutralised to its own in-frame 18% grey card (card reads a clean neutral, no residual warm/cool/green cast; per-channel spread within ~3 levels) with the card mid-grey within ~4 levels of a common target across all six. Full-res (~4000x5000). This is the 'grade the reference region where it still exists' rule made explicit: card-neutrality is checked here, where a correct neutralisation genuinely reads neutral, and is deliberately NOT checked on the downstream warm-graded master (which tints the card along with the whole frame).

outputs.name: signature_look_masters_x6
outputs.spec: The six DELIVERED signature-graded look masters as one matched set: on top of each retained neutralised master, the single shared authored signature grade is applied as a SEPARATE downstream step — a global warm temperature bias + an authored exposure/contrast/clarity/vibrance curve with a lifted-but-controlled matte black shadow foot + a masked hue accent — with skin protected per look so the founder's face stays natural. Because this warm grade intentionally tints the WHOLE frame including the in-frame grey card, card-neutrality is NOT re-checked on this delivery (neutrality is graded upstream on neutralized_card_masters_x6). Acceptance (grader-checked HERE): the same authored signature recipe applied consistently head-to-head across all six (one deliberate identity, not six snapshots), with skin kept natural (no orange/plastic face). Full-res (~4000x5000). Accompanied by a per-look report of the neutralising white-balance and exposure move applied and the skin protection used.

outputs.name: signature_hero_color_16x9.jpg
outputs.spec: The finished signature hero (look 01) fully produced: neutralised to its card and carrying the signature grade, eyes and teeth selectively brightened via a masked lift (skin texture and face shape untouched), the founder separated from the backdrop by a soft blur applied through a background-only mask, then reframed by an honest off-centre crop of the tall 4000x5000 frame down to a wide 16:9 landscape hero (e.g. 2400x1350) with the subject and headroom preserved and clean negative space on one side for an overlaid headline — the grey card cropped OUT of frame in this delivered product. Downscale-only, no pixels invented. JPEG, sRGB.

outputs.name: signature_hero_mono.jpg
outputs.spec: A tasteful monochrome alternate of the finished colour hero, same 16:9 framing, authored from primitives — a full desaturation across the hue bands to a neutral black-and-white base followed by an editorial tonal shape (contrast + black point + a subtle GLOBAL warm tone applied whole-image across the desaturated frame, a global temperature/tint bias, NOT a per-luminance split-tone) — NOT a one-click canned monochrome preset. JPEG, sRGB.

outputs.name: profile_avatar_1x1.jpg
outputs.spec: A 1:1 avatar/profile crop (1000x1000) derived from the finished colour hero, subject-centred, grey card excluded. JPEG, sRGB.

outputs.name: profile_banner_1584x396.jpg
outputs.spec: A 1584x396 wide profile-banner crop derived from the finished colour hero, subject offset with clear text room, grey card excluded. JPEG, sRGB.

outputs.name: profile_look_set_x6
outputs.spec: The six finished per-look portrait crops (grey card cropped OUT) that bind into the brand board — one card-excluded portrait per graded look master, subject-framed. Card-exclusion is checked HERE (no card pixels present); the neutrality tolerance is NOT evaluated on these crops (it is graded on signature_look_masters_x6). Downscale-only from the ~4000x5000 masters, sRGB.

outputs.name: monogram_logomark.svg
outputs.spec: Clean vectorized SVG of the 'AV' ring monogram, single-colour paths with open counters intact, scalable for print + large web, traced only after a crop-to-bounds prep of the flat transparent monogram.

outputs.name: personal_brand_board.pdf
outputs.spec: A print-ready ~300 DPI US Letter (8.5x11) portrait personal-brand board exported from the one-file-per-row InDesign data-merge: exactly six pages (page-count = row-count = 6), one look per page, each page binding its look_name/founder_name/tagline verbatim from the roster with that look's finished portrait dropped into the @portrait frame and the vectorized monogram dropped into the @logomark frame — both by merge bind, never free-form placement. The signature hero look is simply page 1 of the merged document (no per-record named export).

outputs.name: grade_params_report
outputs.spec: A short accompanying note (secondary to the images, NOT the primary deliverable) in which the agent reports, per look: the corrective white-balance move made to hit that look's card (temperature and tint direction/magnitude), the exposure delta, and the skin-protection HSL trim applied, plus a one-line confirmation that each look's card reads neutral and lands on the common mid-grey target. This makes 'matched to the card' verifiable rather than asserted. The agent reports the parameters IT APPLIED (it set them) — it does not read or report any pixel/hex/channel value.

connector_workflow.inputs_from: look01_signature_raw.jpg, look02_window_raw.jpg, look03_practical_raw.jpg, look04_neutral_raw.jpg, look05_mixed_raw.jpg, look06_softbox_raw.jpg, monogram_flat.png
connector_workflow.note: Bring the six raw studio look captures and the flat monogram into the working project in one load so every downstream edit runs against real asset references. Plumbing only, not the difficulty.
Level the slight tilt on the signature look before any tonal or reframe work, so the later off-centre crop is measured against a true horizon.

NEUTRALISE ONLY on the signature look, and RETAIN the result: using the in-frame grey card as ground truth, dial temperature, tint and exposure so the card reads truly neutral and its mid-grey lands at the common target. This retained card-neutral master (look01_neutral) is the artifact card-neutrality is graded on, and the numbers chosen here define the common white point the other five must hit. Do NOT author the signature grade in this call — the grade is a SEPARATE downstream step (n4) so the neutrality check is never run on a warm-tinted file. Reason the correction from THIS look's card. Report the move for the params note.

Apply the authored signature personal-brand grade as a SEPARATE downstream step on the retained neutral master (card-neutrality is NOT re-checked here). Doable authored recipe from primitives: a global warm temperature shift + an authored exposure/contrast/clarity/vibrance curve with a soft matte black shadow foot via lifted-but-controlled blacks. NO split-tone / no per-luminance hue claim (temperature/tint are global; highlights/shadows move luminance only). NOT a preset and NOT auto-tone. This warm grade intentionally tints the whole frame including the card, which is exactly why neutrality was graded upstream on look01_neutral, not here.
Select the founder so skin can be protected and the authored hue accent placed without touching the background. Semantic subject selection; returns a mask URI.

Masked skin protection + the authored hue accent that completes the signature look: inside the subject mask, trim the orange/red hue-band saturation and settle its luminance so the shared warm grade and vibrance never push the founder's face orange or plastic — a small in-band trim, no near-complementary rotation. image_adjust_hsl is the only masked recolor path. Produces the DELIVERED signature look graded master (look01_graded); card-neutrality is not graded on this warm master.

Neutralise look 02 to its OWN in-frame grey card and land its card mid-grey on the common target, RETAINING look02_neutral as its card-neutral reference master (neutrality graded here). Reason this look's white-balance and exposure correction from its own card — do NOT reuse the signature look's numbers. No grade in this call. Report the move.

Apply the shared authored signature grade on look02_neutral as a SEPARATE downstream step: the same global warm temperature bias + authored exposure/contrast/clarity/vibrance curve and matte black foot as the signature look. Same recipe constants; no split-tone; card-neutrality not re-checked on this warm master.
Select the founder for skin-safe grading.
Masked skin protection tuned to this look's residual cast. Produces the delivered look 02 graded master (look02_graded).

Neutralise look 03 to its own in-frame grey card and land its mid-grey on the common target, RETAINING look03_neutral as its card-neutral reference master (neutrality graded here). Reason this look's correction from its own card — decide what its card actually needs rather than reusing another look's move. No grade in this call. Report the move.

Apply the shared authored signature grade on look03_neutral as a SEPARATE downstream step (same warm-bias/curve/matte-foot constants, no split-tone). Card-neutrality not re-checked on this warm master.
Select the founder for skin-safe grading.
Masked skin protection; clear any residual colour left in the skin band after neutralisation. Produces the delivered look 03 graded master (look03_graded).

Bring look 04 onto the shared target: read its in-frame grey card and decide what correction it actually needs to land the card neutral at the common mid-grey — reason from THIS card, not from the other looks' moves — RETAINING look04_neutral as its card-neutral reference master (neutrality graded here). No grade in this call. Report the move you applied.
Apply the shared authored signature grade on look04_neutral as a SEPARATE downstream step (same constants, no split-tone). Card-neutrality not re-checked on this warm master.
Select the founder for skin-safe grading.
Masked skin protection. Produces the delivered look 04 graded master (look04_graded).

Neutralise look 05 to its own in-frame grey card and land its mid-grey on the common target, RETAINING look05_neutral as its card-neutral reference master (neutrality graded here). Drive the card grey to neutral as the reference and reason this look's correction from its own card. No grade in this call. Report the move.
Apply the shared authored signature grade on look05_neutral as a SEPARATE downstream step (same constants, no split-tone). Card-neutrality not re-checked on this warm master.
Select the founder for skin-safe grading.
Masked skin protection. Produces the delivered look 05 graded master (look05_graded).

Neutralise look 06 to its own in-frame grey card and land its mid-grey on the common target, RETAINING look06_neutral as its card-neutral reference master (neutrality graded here). Reason this look's correction independently from its own card; a fix copied from another look can land it off the shared white point. No grade in this call. Report the move.

Apply the shared authored signature grade on look06_neutral as a SEPARATE downstream step (same constants, no split-tone). Card-neutrality not re-checked on this warm master. NEUTRALITY SPLIT SUMMARY: steps 3/7/11/15/19/23 produce look01_neutral..look06_neutral = neutralized_card_masters_x6 (the retained card-neutral masters, where card-neutrality + common white point are graded); steps 6/10/14/18/22/26 produce look01_graded..look06_graded = signature_look_masters_x6 (the delivered warm signature-graded set, whose card-neutrality is NEVER re-checked).
Select the founder for skin-safe grading.
Masked skin protection. Produces the delivered look 06 graded master (look06_graded).
On the graded signature master, semantically select the eyes and teeth to drive a selective, believable brightening. Names a real object/part (not a hue, band or coordinate); returns a mask URI.

Masked selective lift: brighten the light portions ONLY within the eyes/teeth mask so the retouch is tasteful and local — skin texture and face shape untouched. image_apply_adjustments accepts a mask, so this is a genuine local edit, not a whole-image lift that would blow the face. Consumes the graded master + step-27 mask.
Select the founder so the background can be isolated for the separation blur.
Invert the subject mask to a background-only mask.

Soft blur applied THROUGH the background mask only, so the founder stays sharp and the backdrop softens — the dynamic subject-from-backdrop separation, without touching the subject. Consumes the retouched image + step-30 mask.

Honest off-centre reframe of the tall 4000x5000 signature frame down to a wide 16:9 landscape hero (~2400x1350): keep the subject and headroom, place the empty backdrop side as clean headline negative space, and crop the lower-frame grey card OUT in the same move. Downscale/reframe of existing pixels only — never larger than the source, no pixels invented. onSubjectClipping='extract'. DELIVERABLE.
Authored monochrome pass 1: pull saturation to zero across the hue bands to a neutral black-and-white base (a full desaturation, not a hue rotation). First half of the agent-authored mono build.

Authored monochrome pass 2: shape the black-and-white tonally — set contrast and black point for an editorial feel and add a subtle GLOBAL warm tone across the whole desaturated frame (a global temperature/tint warm bias applied whole-image, NOT a per-luminance split-tone) — so the mono alternate is an authored treatment, not a one-click canned monochrome. DELIVERABLE.
Derive the 1:1 avatar crop (1000x1000) from the finished colour hero, subject-centred, card already excluded. onSubjectClipping='extract', downscale-only. DELIVERABLE.
Derive the 1584x396 wide profile-banner crop from the finished colour hero, subject offset for text room. onSubjectClipping='extract', downscale-only. DELIVERABLE.
Card-excluded portrait crop of the signature graded master for the brand board (subject-framed, grey card cropped OUT). Downscale-only from the ~4000x5000 master. Part of profile_look_set_x6.
Card-excluded portrait crop of the look 02 graded master for the brand board. Downscale-only. Part of profile_look_set_x6.
Card-excluded portrait crop of the look 03 graded master for the brand board. Downscale-only. Part of profile_look_set_x6.
Card-excluded portrait crop of the look 04 graded master for the brand board. Downscale-only. Part of profile_look_set_x6.
Card-excluded portrait crop of the look 05 graded master for the brand board. Downscale-only. Part of profile_look_set_x6.
Card-excluded portrait crop of the look 06 graded master for the brand board; look_signature_crop..look_press_crop form profile_look_set_x6. Downscale-only.

Prep-before-trace: crop the flat transparent monogram to its own tight bounds so vectorize traces only the mark, not the transparent padding. The ground is already transparent and the ink is a single flat colour, so no knock-to-transparency is needed here.
Trace the prepared flat solid-colour monogram into a clean scalable SVG logomark with open counters intact. DELIVERABLE.

connector_workflow.inputs_from: look_signature_crop.jpg, look_feature_crop.jpg, look_editorial_crop.jpg, look_profile_crop.jpg, look_speaker_crop.jpg, look_press_crop.jpg, monogram_logomark.svg
connector_workflow.note: Initialize an upload session for the six finished per-look portrait crops plus the vector monogram so the merge can resolve them by the @portrait column (per-row portrait) and the @logomark column (shared mark). Files uploaded under the exact names the roster references.
Finalize the upload; returns the asset URNs the roster's @portrait and @logomark columns resolve to for each single-record board page.

One-file-per-row InDesign data-merge: bind each of the six roster rows (look_name/founder_name/tagline) into the authored SINGLE-RECORD .indd's live <<fields>> and resolve BOTH image columns per row — drop that row's finished portrait crop into the @portrait frame AND the vectorized monogram (from @logomark, the same SVG in every row) into the @logomark frame — producing EXACTLY ONE merged page per row (six pages). Binding the portrait and mark through the image columns is their only connector-doable path (free-form image-at-coordinates placement is banned). [T] requires the hand-authored template with its two merge-wired image frames; a convert_pdf_to_indd template would not bind and a multi-up grid cannot be produced.

Export the merged single-record pages to a press-ready ~300 DPI US Letter PDF, one look per page. document_render_layout exports the WHOLE merged multi-page document in a single call — it cannot export one named record on its own, so the signature hero look is simply page 1. Acceptance: page-count = row-count = 6; if fewer, the merge collapsed rows and failed. DELIVERABLE.

chaining_note: Strict output-to-input chaining across four tributaries that converge on one cohesive personal-brand delivery. Single ingest (1) loads the six raws and the monogram. SIGNATURE tributary (establishes the target): auto_straighten (2) -> image_apply_adjustments (3, NEUTRALISE ONLY to the common target = the RETAINED card-neutral master look01_neutral, whose reported numbers ARE the shared white point) -> image_apply_adjustments (4, the authored signature grade applied as a SEPARATE downstream step -> look01_graded_base) -> select_subject (5) -> masked image_adjust_hsl (6, skin protection + hue accent) = look01_graded. Five ALTERNATE-look sub-chains each fan from assets_uploaded and reason a DIFFERENT neutralisation to the SAME target, then take the same separate grade + skin protection: look02 (7->10), look03 (11->14), look04 (15->18), look05 (19->22), look06 (23->26). CRITICAL SPLIT: steps 3/7/11/15/19/23 produce look01_neutral..look06_neutral = neutralized_card_masters_x6 (the retained card-neutral masters, where card-neutrality + the common white point are graded, because the card is still genuinely neutral on them); steps 6/10/14/18/22/26 produce look01_graded..look06_graded = signature_look_masters_x6 (the delivered warm signature-graded set, whose card-neutrality is deliberately NOT re-checked because the warm grade tints the card along with the frame). HERO-finish tributary consumes look01_graded: select_by_prompt eyes+teeth (27) -> masked lift (28) -> select_subject (29) -> invert (30) -> masked gaussian_blur (31) -> honest 16:9 reframe with the card cropped out (32) = signature_hero_color_16x9; from that hero, an authored mono (desaturate 33 -> tonal shape with a whole-image global warm tone 34 = signature_hero_mono) and two profile crops (35 avatar, 36 banner). BOARD tributary: six card-excluded portrait crops off the six graded masters (37-42 = profile_look_set_x6), the monogram prep-before-trace (crop_to_bounds 43 -> vectorize 44 = monogram_logomark.svg), then upload (45) -> finalize (46) -> document_merge_data_layout (47, consuming the authored single-record .indd + roster + urns, resolving @portrait per row and the shared @logomark, one page per row) -> document_render_layout (48, single export of the whole six-page merged doc). Cross-asset consistency is NOT a repeated recipe — each of steps 3/7/11/15/19/23 is a distinct neutralisation whose only invariant is the shared target from step 3, and the agent reports all six so the match is auditable. Every step after the single ingest consumes a named prior output.
difficulty_rationale: Long-horizon flagship with difficulty from DEPTH, not plumbing: 48 connector calls, 15 distinct Adobe tools across three groups (image_* grading/masking/FX/crop/vector, asset_* storage, document_* merge/export), well above the >=10 call / >=6 distinct-tool floor even after stripping the single upload and the two merge-upload steps. The core is not a repeated recipe: each of the six neutralisations is a DIFFERENT reasoned decision (a warm frame cooled, a cool frame warmed, a colour-tinge frame corrected on a different axis, a genuinely-neutral frame held, a split-cast frame compromised, a second cool frame corrected close-but-not-equal to the first) all forced to converge on one measurable target — the in-frame 18% grey card and a common mid-grey graded on the RETAINED card-neutral masters — so a blanket batch correction cannot pass. Neutralisation is a SEPARATE retained step from the grade so the card-neutrality check runs where the card is still genuinely neutral, never on the warm delivery. Layered on top: a connector-doable authored signature grade built from image_apply_adjustments primitives (a global warm temperature bias, gentle contrast, a soft matte black shadow foot via lifted blacks, restrained clarity, a whisper of vibrance) applied as shared constants plus a masked image_adjust_hsl hue accent — no split-tone / no per-luminance hue claim (not a preset, not auto-tone); per-look masked image_adjust_hsl skin protection so the grade never oranges the face; a masked selective eyes/teeth lift and a background-only separation blur on the hero (both requiring a mask threaded into a later edit, not a global push); an honest gen-free 16:9 reframe that also crops the card out; an authored two-pass monochrome (desaturate + tonal shape with a whole-image global warm tone, not a split-tone); a prep-before-trace vectorize; and a two-image-column one-file-per-row data-merge into a hand-authored single-record template ending in a press-ready PDF. Respects every hard limit: no generative fill/expand, no text-to-image, no compositing, no upscaling, no from-scratch design; image_crop_and_resize is downscale-only with onSubjectClipping='extract'; convert_pdf_to_indd is NOT used (the template is a supplied authored .indd); deprecated tool names (image_adjust_color_temperature, _highlights, _vibrance_and_saturation, _brightness_and_contrast) are replaced by image_apply_adjustments; image_apply_monochromatic_tint is replaced by an authored desaturate+tone build; image_fill_area and whole-image image_apply_color_overlay are never used.
hardness_rationale: FAILURE GATE (a wrong DECISION, not a self-measurement): every one of the six looks carries a physical 18% grey card in frame, and the acceptance test is that each card — graded on its RETAINED card-NEUTRAL master (neutralized_card_masters_x6, the pre-grade file where the card is still genuinely neutral) — reads truly neutral (per-channel spread within ~3 levels) with the card mid-grey within ~4 levels of a common target across all six, and the agent must REPORT the per-look temperature/tint/exposure move it applied. Neutralisation and the signature grade are SEPARATE steps precisely so this check lands on the neutral master and never on the warm-graded delivery (the warm grade tints the card along with the frame, so grading neutrality there would fail a CORRECT grade). A naive agent that copies one white-balance across the batch, or that runs per-look auto-tone, leaves the cool looks blue and the tinged look off and fails the gate. Additional decision gates: the eyes/teeth brightening must be MASKED (a global lift blows the whole face), the separation blur must ride a background-only mask (blurring globally softens the subject), and the merge must emit page-count = row-count = 6 (one-file-per-row). HUMAN-HARD ELEMENTS: (1) cross-asset neutralisation of six differently-lit headshots to a shared measurable card target on differing correction axes (temperature vs green/magenta tint vs split-cast compromise), which a novice cannot match by eye and which demands the counter-intuitive insight that a matched OUTPUT needs DIFFERENT per-frame corrections; (2) masked per-look skin protection so the signature grade never oranges the face; plus prep-before-trace vectorize discipline and an authored (not canned) monochrome. THE TRAPS (kept out of the brief and steps, disclosed only here and in realism_notes): look 04 was shot under clean neutral light and the founder's ochre wardrobe is genuinely warm, so its card is already neutral — the naive path batch-applies the warm/cool corrections used elsewhere and strips a real colour; look 06 is cool like look 02 but a subtly different blue, so copying look 02's numbers lands it off the shared white point; and the brief's 'make them one look' invites one global slider that cannot serve opposite casts. MEASURABLE ACCEPTANCE (decoupled so no artifact is graded on a region it crops away OR on a grade that intentionally recolours the reference): (a) grey card neutral (~3-level channel spread) and one shared mid-grey (~4-level tolerance) evaluated on the six RETAINED card-NEUTRAL masters (neutralized_card_masters_x6), never on the warm signature-graded set and never on a card-removed crop; (b) the delivered signature grade checked for consistent head-to-head application and natural skin on signature_look_masters_x6 (card-neutrality NOT re-checked there); (c) card-EXCLUSION checked separately on the hero, the profile crops, and profile_look_set_x6 (no card pixels present); plus the hero reframed to 16:9 with negative space, avatar 1000x1000, banner 1584x396, an authored mono, a clean open-counter vector monogram, exactly six board pages at ~300 DPI US Letter, and a per-look applied-parameter report so 'matched to the card' is verifiable rather than asserted.
